How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
For the Signature Wax Melt Warmer we discussed, start with 2–3 wax-melt bears in its silicone dish. Once you’ve tried that, you can adjust the amount to suit how strong you like the scent. (Signature warmer guidance)
When you’re ready to change scents, let the wax cool first. Then remove the silicone dish and pop the used wax into the bin—no scraping needed.
